description: User-facing help for every registered action and screen-level focus target.

help.summary: Choose a benchmark task or review prior results.
help.usage: Use the navigation keys to open a screen, then press ? for the actions available there.

help.summary: Choose which supported agent will execute the benchmark.
help.usage: Select an available agent before continuing; unsupported agents remain unavailable until installed and verified.

help.summary: Choose the provider that supplies the selected agent model.
help.usage: Review the provider capabilities and choose one compatible with the selected agent before moving on.

help.summary: Choose the model exposed by the selected provider.
help.usage: Select a model reported by the provider and check its availability before continuing with setup.

help.summary: Review the benchmark settings that will be used for the run.
help.usage: Check each default and edit it when needed; changes are applied only after you confirm the review.

help.summary: Choose a development fixture or approved helper without exposing a provider secret.
help.usage: For local development, enroll, test, rotate, or reset the digest-only fixture and heed its development-only warning. For production, use the approved helper and wait for runner-authored status.

help.summary: Create a deterministic local development credential fixture.
help.usage: Press E on Authentication to generate digest-only metadata; this is explicitly development-only and never contacts a provider.

help.summary: Check that the local development fixture is usable.
help.usage: Press T after enrollment; a bounded status changes to tested without exposing a credential or requiring authorization.

help.summary: Generate a fresh generation of the local fixture metadata.
help.usage: Press R after enrollment or testing; the old digest is replaced and the new generation remains development-only.

help.summary: Clear local fixture metadata before starting again.
help.usage: Press X on Authentication to remove digest projections and return to a reset state; no provider secret is touched.

help.summary: Select the local development authentication method.
help.usage: Press F on Authentication to use the warning-labeled fixture instead of an external production helper.

help.summary: Select the provider's explicitly unauthenticated development mode.
help.usage: Press N only for a provider that supports no authentication; the TUI does not claim production authorization.

help.summary: Discard the current fixture attempt and restart its bounded generation.
help.usage: Press Z after cancellation or an interrupted attempt; previous digest metadata is cleared before retrying.

help.summary: Choose whether this benchmark records reproducible activity.
help.usage: Enable recording when you need an auditable run artifact, or leave it off for an ordinary measurement.

help.summary: Choose the policy for replaying an existing benchmark recording.
help.usage: Select replay only when a compatible recording is available and verify its identity before execution.

help.summary: Review every setup choice before the configuration is completed.
help.usage: Confirm the displayed agent, provider, model, and policies; go back to correct any choice before finishing.

help.summary: Edit the active value, move between steps, or open contextual help.
help.usage: Type to edit, use Backspace to correct, press Enter to continue, and press ? for this help window.

help.summary: Review and edit the frontend connection and run defaults.
help.usage: Move between settings with the arrow keys and confirm an edited value with Enter.

help.summary: Choose benchmark groups and the individual measures to run.
help.usage: Search or move through the catalog; Space toggles the focused measure and a toggles visible measures.

help.summary: Start a configured benchmark and monitor its progress.
help.usage: Review the selected measures before pressing Enter; Ctrl-C requests cancellation of an active run.

help.summary: Inspect completed and active runs that can feed a report.
help.usage: Refresh the list when new runs finish, then select a run to inspect or compare.

help.summary: Compare selected benchmark runs and inspect their measurements.
help.usage: Select compatible runs in Recent runs, then choose Compare to review differences.

help.summary: Find the action, key binding, or explanation for the current screen.
help.usage: Type to filter the catalog, move through matching entries, and press Esc to return.

help.summary: Close the ASB TUI while leaving the benchmark runner running.
help.usage: Press q from any screen when you have finished using the frontend.

help.summary: Return to the previous screen without changing the runner.
help.usage: Press Esc when the current screen or overlay is no longer needed.

help.summary: Open the landing screen and choose another benchmark task.
help.usage: Press h from any screen to return to the frontend starting point.

help.summary: Open the settings used by the frontend before a run.
help.usage: Press c to review connection and benchmark defaults.

help.summary: Open the catalog for choosing benchmark groups and measures.
help.usage: Press m before a run to change which measurements will be collected.

help.summary: Open the screen for starting or stopping a benchmark run.
help.usage: Press s after configuration and measure selection are ready.

help.summary: Open the list of recent runs used for inspection and reports.
help.usage: Press r to review available run history.

help.summary: Open report analysis for comparing selected benchmark runs.
help.usage: Press p after selecting report inputs.

help.summary: Open searchable help for actions and key bindings.
help.usage: Press ? whenever you need guidance for the visible context.

help.summary: Reconnect the frontend to the negotiated ASB control endpoint.
help.usage: Use reconnect after a temporary connection loss, then verify the capability state.

help.summary: Focus the search field for filtering the current help catalog.
help.usage: Press / and type a word such as report or measure to narrow the entries.

help.summary: Select or deselect every measure currently visible in the catalog.
help.usage: Press a after filtering or grouping the catalog to change the whole visible set.

help.summary: Select or deselect the measure currently under the cursor.
help.usage: Move to a measure and press Space; the selection marker shows the resulting state.

help.summary: Search the nested benchmark catalog without changing hidden selections.
help.usage: Press / and type a bounded query matching a pool, group, benchmark, or measure, then move through the visible results.

help.summary: Choose which supported benchmark pool supplies the campaign choices.
help.usage: Press P to move between pools; changing the pool clears incompatible choices and requires an explicit new selection.

help.summary: Select or clear visible benchmarks and available measures in one group.
help.usage: Press g after filtering the catalog; hidden groups and measures remain unchanged.

help.summary: Select or clear all available measures belonging to the focused benchmark.
help.usage: Press b to review the benchmark-level choice; unavailable measures remain visibly excluded.

help.summary: Start the configured benchmark with the selected measures.
help.usage: Press Enter only after checking the runner, configuration, and measure summary.

help.summary: Ask ASB to stop the benchmark that is currently running.
help.usage: Press Ctrl-C once and wait for the runner to report its terminal state.

help.summary: Fetch the latest recent-run projections from the ASB endpoint.
help.usage: Press f when a run may have completed or the list appears stale.

help.summary: Compare the selected report runs using matching measurements.
help.usage: Press v after choosing the runs and confirm that their measure sets are compatible.

help.summary: Refresh the runner-owned provider and model catalog.
help.usage: Use this after connecting or changing provider setup; only supported, authenticated catalog entries are shown.

help.summary: Build and show the reviewed configuration summary before applying it.
help.usage: Press V on Configuration; the bundle is validated against the current provider and benchmark selections and no file is changed.

help.summary: Persist the reviewed configuration bundle atomically.
help.usage: Press A only after reviewing the digest and selections in Preflight; a configured private store is required and failures retain the pending bundle.

help.summary: Estimate the selected agent and workload recording matrix.
help.usage: Review the bounded tuple estimate before creating a capture plan; estimation does not contact the provider.

help.summary: Create a runner-owned plan for recording selected workloads.
help.usage: Check the provider, model, agents, and workload scope before confirming the plan.

help.summary: Explicitly authorize the planned provider response capture.
help.usage: Confirm only after reviewing the scope; a second confirmation dispatch starts the campaign.

help.summary: Refresh authoritative progress for the recording campaign.
help.usage: Use this while capture is active; the runner remains authoritative for coverage and state.

help.summary: Request cancellation of the active recording campaign.
help.usage: Cancel when capture should stop, then wait for the runner lifecycle response.

help.summary: Reconcile a recording campaign interrupted during capture.
help.usage: Use this only when the runner reports reconciliation is required before continuing.

help.summary: Activate offline defaults after complete recording coverage.
help.usage: This remains disabled until every requested tuple is complete and the runner confirms readiness.

help.summary: Filter benchmark measures by group or name.
help.usage: Type a term to narrow the catalog, then move through matching measures and press Space to change selection.

help.summary: Choose whether this benchmark measure will run.
help.usage: Move to a measure and press Space; the selection marker shows whether it is included.

help.summary: Select or clear the visible measures in this group.
help.usage: Press the group toggle to change only the filtered members without altering hidden selections.

help.summary: Filter nested benchmark pools, groups, benchmarks, and measures.
help.usage: Type a bounded query to narrow visible choices; filtering never changes selections that are hidden.

help.summary: Choose the supported benchmark pool for this campaign.
help.usage: Select one pool before reviewing groups and benchmarks; moving pools clears stale choices rather than guessing.

help.summary: Select or clear visible benchmarks and their available measures.
help.usage: Press g to change only the focused group while preserving choices outside the current search.

help.summary: Include a benchmark and its available measures in the campaign.
help.usage: Press b on a benchmark to select it, then review individual measures before handing the exact campaign to ASB.

help.summary: Edit the setting used by the next benchmark.
help.usage: Press Enter to focus, type a bounded value, use Backspace to correct it, press Enter to commit the valid draft, then Ctrl-S to apply it. Invalid text is retained visibly and never persisted.

help.summary: Find a configuration setting by name or description.
help.usage: Type a bounded query to filter settings while preserving the draft values already entered.

help.summary: Shows the provider, model, agent, and recording readiness reported by ASB.
help.usage: Review this status before applying setup changes or starting a run; unavailable fields remain disabled until the runner responds.

help.summary: Shows the exact digest-bound provider and benchmark configuration that will be applied.
help.usage: Press V on Configuration to review the provider, model, agents, pool, measures, and development-only warning before applying.

help.summary: Shows the current benchmark lifecycle and progress.
help.usage: Read this status before starting, cancelling, reconnecting, or leaving the run-control screen.

help.summary: Start a benchmark with the validated configuration and measures.
help.usage: Press Enter only after the runner, configuration, and selected-measure summary are ready.

help.summary: Request cancellation of the active benchmark run.
help.usage: Press Ctrl-C once, then wait for ASB to report a terminal result before retrying.

help.summary: Select a recent run for inspection or comparison.
help.usage: Move through newest-first history and select a run whose measurements and status you trust.

help.summary: Fetch the latest run history from the ASB endpoint.
help.usage: Press f after a run finishes or when the visible history may be stale.

help.summary: Choose a run to inspect evidence, measures, failures, and provenance.
help.usage: Select a completed run, review its evidence and measure status, then use its recovery guidance before comparing results.

help.summary: Compare selected runs after reviewing evidence and compatibility.
help.usage: Press v after selecting inputs; incompatible provider, model, catalog, configuration, or evidence is never ranked as comparable.

help.summary: Filter contextual help by action, screen, or topic.
help.usage: Press /, type a bounded query, and move through matching entries to find the current guidance.

help.summary: Read the explanation and key binding for this context.
help.usage: Move through entries with the navigation keys and press Esc when you understand the action.

help.summary: Move safely between the available TUI screens.
help.usage: Use the documented keys or Tab, and press Esc to return from an overlay without changing data.

help.summary: Shows whether the frontend has an authenticated ASB connection.
help.usage: Reconnect only after checking the status message; unavailable or stale responses remain disabled.

help.summary: Replay the explicitly selected authenticated cassette offline.
help.usage: Select a cassette from the runner-owned catalog first; no default or live fallback is allowed.

help.summary: Move the explicit offline cassette selection through the runner catalog.
help.usage: Press ] to select a published digest before pressing J to replay; no implicit fallback is used.
